subject: Runway extension & credit-split proposal for Clearline RFP
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Mercer <ava.mercer@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: longer trial runway + credit split for RFP bake-off

Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Redwood throughput looked promising for our clinical summarization workload. Our procurement and architecture teams raised two asks before we lock in the bake-off schedule: 1) can Clearline get a longer trial runway (we’d like 6–8 weeks rather than 2) to complete integrations and end-to-end evaluation; and 2) can the trial credits be split to support two parallel proof-of-concept cohorts (frontend + batch ingest) without exceeding the current budget?

We have procurement constraints (attached timeline) and a tight decision window the week of Dec 13. If you can outline a credit split and any internal approval steps, that should help speed sign-off.

Appreciate it — Sam

--
Sam Taylor
Head of Data Platforms | Clearline Health
sam.taylor@clearlinehealth.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: clearline-procurement-timeline.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: longer trial runway + credit split for RFP bake-off

Sam —

Thanks for laying out the asks. Short answer: we can support an extended runway and a two-cohort credit split, but we need to lock a few guardrails so the team hits apples-to-apples comparisons across vendors. Proposed approach:

- Runway: extend to 8 weeks with milestones at week 2 (basic integration), week 5 (baseline perf/quality check), week 8 (final bake-off).
- Credit split: allocate 60% to the online cohort (low-latency inferencing) and 40% to batch ingest/embedding work. We can top-up by up to 20% for a one-time competitive-match clause if you provide evidence of an equivalent vendor offer.
- Acceptance criteria: shared eval prompt set and a short tracer script to surface token counts so we can map cost vs accuracy.

I've attached a quick CSV with the proposed credit split and the top-up clause recorded. If this looks good, Neha will confirm approvals and Soojin can scope the infra requirements for the cohorts.

I'll wait for your procurement timeline confirmation.

Best,
Markus
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 650 555 2199

Attachments: redwood-proposed-credit-split.csv (attachment stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Approvals needed: Clearline runway/top-up guardrails

Markus / Soojin —

I reviewed the proposed split and the conditional top-up language. A few notes from pricing/legal ops:

- We can approve an 8-week runway as a one-off for this RFP but need the following in writing: target milestones (Markus' week 2/5/8) and confirmation that Clearline will share the canonical prompt set (to ensure identical evals).
- The competitive-match top-up (up to 20%) must be accompanied by a vendor offer PDF and a signed mutual-action-plan that enumerates deliverables and KPIs.
- For billing, finance prefers a single invoice-backed credit tranche we can escrow internally; we can offer an upfront voucher claim + conditional top-up once the vendor evidence arrives.

I attached a short summary for legal that highlights the billing/contract asks — if you want, I can draft the MSA amendment language for a limited trial term.

Neha
Director, Pricing & GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: legal-terms-summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Ava Mercer <ava.mercer@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearlinehealth.com>, procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:39:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: longer trial runway + credit split for RFP bake-off

Neha / Markus —

Thanks — procurement confirms they can accept the milestones and will provide the vendor comparison PDF (we expect an equivalent cloud vendor offer next week). We prefer the split you proposed (60/40). A couple of clarifications:

1) To satisfy our compliance team we need logging/trace visibility for the batch cohort (token-level counts, request IDs). Will Redwood be able to surface that?
2) Procurement would prefer the escrow-style voucher approach if Redwood can issue an invoice that credits against usage (we can sign the MAM to enable that).

Attaching the procurement timeline for visibility. We should aim to finalize the MAM this week so we can kick off the long-run trial the week of Nov 29.

Ava
Procurement Manager | Clearline Health
procurement@clearlinehealth.com

Attachments: clearline-procurement-timeline.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearlinehealth.com>, Ava Mercer <ava.mercer@clearlinehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: longer trial runway + credit split for RFP bake-off

Team —

Great — happy to proceed. Quick summary / next steps (mutual action plan):

1) Redwood to provision 8-week trial starting Nov 29, 2026.
2) Credits: 60% online (low-latency), 40% batch. Initial voucher issued for 75% of total tranche; up to 20% top-up pending competitive vendor evidence.
3) Milestones: Week 2 (integration smoke test), Week 5 (baseline perf/quality snapshot), Week 8 (final evaluation).
4) Observability: Soojin will enable token-level logging and provide a small tracer script so both parties can reconcile counts.
5) Legal/Billing: Neha will send the MSA amendment + invoice-backed voucher template; Clearline procurement to sign MAM and upload vendor offer for top-up eligibility.

Action owners: Soojin (instrumentation) — weekday cadence; Neha (contracts/invoice) — draft by close of day Monday; Markus (program owner) — track milestones and confirm voucher issuance.

Sam/Ava, if that aligns I’ll share the MAM draft and a Drive link with the tracker.

Thanks — looking forward to a good bake-off.

Best,
Markus
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 650 555 2199

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.md (attachment stub), https://drive.example/redwood/clearline/MA-Plan (link)
